notes.title: Patch 0.28 – Steam Deck Fix & Even Easier Fights!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released Patch 0.28, and here’s what’s new:

[h2]🔧Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steam Deck Fix – We resolved a video rendering issue that made the game unplayable on Steam Deck. Now, you can enjoy the game smoothly on the go!
[*]Even Easier Fights – We’ve adjusted combat difficulty (again!) based on your feedback, making battles even more accessible.
[/list]

[h2]🔜 Coming Next[/h2]
While the game is already fully playable with an Xbox controller, we’re working on making controller support more robust. The next update will ensure that the UI properly adapts to the input system you’re using, making for a smoother experience across all control methods.

As always, thanks for your support, and let us know what you think! 🚀

notes.title: Patch 0.27
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Update – Small Tweaks![/h1]

Thank you for all the amazing feedback—you’re helping make the game even better!

Here’s what’s new in today’s update:

[list]
[*] [b]Fairer Fights[/b] – Knocking out a crocodile now fully restores your stamina, making battles a little less grueling.
[*] [b]Safer Graphics Changes[/b] – Adjusting quality settings is now more foolproof. If you select High Quality (which requires more GPU and memory), we’ll ask for confirmation before applying the change.

More improvements are on the way—stay tuned!

notes.title: Cat Detective Albert Wilde is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Cat Detective Albert Wilde is OUT NOW![/b] 😊

Our eccentric Cat Detective, Albert Wilde, is finally here! This 6–7 hour playtime game is a fusion of comedy, film noir, detective mystery, science fiction, and narrative. From a technical perspective, you could describe it as something between a walking simulator and an interactive novel, with a strong emphasis on comedy.

[b]Our Journey with this Production:[/b]
Over two years ago, we first presented a demo of the game, titled Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.. We received an incredible amount of love and support from industry events, conferences, and competitions, where it was selected and showcased multiple times. Most importantly, we had the chance to watch people play the game live, enjoy it, and share wonderful feedback with us. These moments encouraged us to continue working on the game, expanding it a bit beyond what we originally envisioned. 😊
Recently, we decided to rename the game to Cat Detective Albert Wilde after noticing that many people remembered it simply as "Cat Detective."

We hope you enjoy it!

We look forward to your feedback 🐾

**We’re a tiny indie team from Greece, passionate about creating games we believe are truly different.

notes.title: Release Date on 24th January 2025
notes.content:
[b]Cat Detective Albert Wilde[/b]'s release date on Steam is [b]January 24, 2025.[/b]

We are excited to announce the release date for our eccentric mystery adventure Cat Detective Albert Wilde, alongside a release date announcement trailer. 

Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a comedy noir, sci - fi mystery game that blends elements of a walking simulator and interactive novel, with a strong focus on humor. 

About the game
A freakish corpse… a pissed-off bookie… a wormhole to another reality… it’s just another day in the office for Albert Wilde, feline private eye. Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a short (6-7 hour runtime) genre-bending adventure set in 1930’s New York, featuring atmospheric visuals, neat minigames, and at least one joke about cat nipples (they have six!). Players must talk, walk and puzzle their way through a murder mystery that’s messier than a fresh hairball, in this hilarious zoological tribute to the golden age of noir.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/a960827fa5d51f4bf9462e6cf7e672ccce49a24f.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

Happy New Year! 🎉

We’re in the final stretch, testing the completed version and wrapping up a few last touches.

Cat Detective Albert Wilde is shaping up to be a 5-hour adventure (at a medium pace), packed with a mysterious story, plenty of jokes, and an intriguing twist as the plot unfolds. notes.title: Rebranding | We are changing the title of the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We want to let you know that we are changing the name of our game from Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. to Cat Detective Albert Wilde.

We've discovered that many people searching for our game often used the words "cat" or "detective" instead of "Albert Wilde" or "Quantum P.I." After a lot of consideration, research, and testing at events, we decided to make the change and add "Cat Detective" to the title.

While Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. captures the vibe of the game, we realized it might be challenging for everyone to remember. By incorporating "Cat Detective," we make it easier for players to find our game using their own words, while still highlighting our protagonist's name, Albert Wilde. 

* All new assets, poster & trailer are coming soon... ; )

notes.title: Updated Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]

We are very close to announcing the release date of the game. Stay tuned!
We are still working on the final version. The game turned out to be bigger than we initially expected. 

In the meantime, we have [b]updated the demo[/b]!

[h2]What's New in the Demo:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased graphic quality overall while keeping the old-school, low-quality vibes.
[*] Introduced save points. The demo has only three save points as it's a small part of the game.
[*] Bug fixes and improvements.
[*] Smaller Demo but Better!
[/list]

As we move towards the final phase of development and the release of the game, we decided to make the public demo smaller. After extensive testing and live presentations, we observed that players are happy with a smaller demo. So, we took the liberty to reduce the public demo slightly (not a lot) to have more exclusive content for special demonstrations. But no worries, the full game will be live very soon!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Dev Update - Changelog Clues
notes.content:
[h1][b]It's finally weekend Detectives![/b][/h1]

But crime does not sleep, nor does finding clues in our changelog...

We have updated the following through your feedback transcriptions, where we improve accessibility, UI/UX and more!

[h2]Where can you Find Albert?[/h2]
We have added our Steam Wishlist, Discord and Twitter links to the game. There will be a notification to wishlist the game upon entering the office and instead of the demo closing down at the end it will ask you to both wishlist and join us over at our Discord as this is very important for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/514fe777b8bf0843c1924f4edeb3b07b73befe6a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Where am I? [/h2]
We have improved the map UI/UX to an extent where you can now see at which location you are, taking away confusion to why you can't fast travel to the market for some milk, while you're already there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/bd0f66f3d9d5e3e688b64ebe208e5b8eb05a6a15.png[/img]

[h2]What's in the bag!?[/h2]
We have fixed a bug where your last inventory item icon would be a wrong icon. 

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
Mouse input now works to select the buttons in the main menu, where before you could only select these with your arrow keys.

[h2]Game States[/h2]
We have resolved conflicts with different game states by defining transitions rules among the game modes (loading, game, main menu, whishlist menu) e.g. if the map is open and you enter the main menu, the input will not affect the underly map selections.

notes.title: Game Update - Putting the 'Quantum' in Quantum P.I.
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, [/h2]

It's that time again when we drop by to let you know how things are going behind the scenes for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

[b][h3]Putting the 'Quantum' in Quantum P.I.[/h3][/b]
We've been working on some of the more science-fiction elements of Albert Wilde recently, getting stuck in with all things multiversal and timey-wimey. 

Looking into concepts behind alternate reality theories and special and general relativity has been really interesting, but they're certainly not the easiest things to wrap your head around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/7ad45685702b8802498a49ad0b63c5a3db5c8d01.jpg[/img]

Consistency and challenge are two important aspects that have to be considered when playing around with these aspects of the sci-fi genre, so lots of research and testing has been involved.

Unsurprisingly, this hasn't been the fastest process for us but we're excited about how it's all coming together and can't wait for you to see how it all ties in with [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

Oh, and of course we had to design [redacted], which maybe you'll get to uncover in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/65d79198b4c65a0ff2d1f6c52aad1bcf47846b72.gif[/img]

And that's that! A lot of work is going on behind the curtains for our kooky cat caper, [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.[/b] but we want to keep some of it under wraps for now. 

Thanks so much for your support, we'll be calling on you detectives soon! 

~ Maria and Andreas, [i]beyondthosehills[/i] 🐱

notes.title: A little look at W.A.S.D Festival
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there,[/h2]

While work on Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. has been going on behind the scenes, we've also been taking this cat for a walk as we've taken part in a few games festivals - including [b]W.A.S.D![/b]

We wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who checked out Quantum P.I. in the Curios Collection and to let you all know that our [b]updated demo will be available on Steam for a little while longer!![/b]

This is the build we cleaned up for W.A.S.D and has a load of fixes and new bits and bobs to make the game a much sleeker experience. So, why not give it a try if you're curious? 🔍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/3695c88c1983b5202440da5dd11a71b05414f2bd.png[/img]

We had such a wonderful experience at the festival and were so thrilled with the feedback we received. It was really exciting and humbling to see people getting to know our disillusioned detective and his game in the flesh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/0db301df7a1dcb014108578411d0f1380815ab9c.jpg[/img]

While we are based in Athens, we were lucky enough to attend W.A.S.D in person this year and were at the Curios stand [strike]almost[/strike] all of Saturday. There were players checking out Albert Wilde all day, with people staying to play through the demo. We were especially thrilled to hear some good laughs from everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/457a2bc25237f391a086b2ef0259c2f915cbe8df.png[/img]

Many players came to speak to us after playing through the demo, which was also really lovely. The main elements people highlighted to us were the art style, with people enjoying the noir vibes, the writing, which we've been working on since Steam Next Fest earlier this year, and Albert Wilde himself, but then how could they not be enamoured with his charm and wit! 

Overall, it was a fantastic experience and we hugely enjoyed talking to players directly! 
We can't wait for the next opportunity we get to see you all again but for now you can dive into the demo and let us know your thoughts!


That's all for now, thanks again for your support!
~ [i]beyondthosehills[/i]

notes.title: Dev Update - Cabins, Construction, and Closing chapters 🐈
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, [/h2]

We're just stopping by to give you a very quick rundown on what's going on behind the scenes for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/b]!

We are so grateful for everyone who's checked out the game or given it a wishlist, so the least we can do is keep you updated. Let's have a look then, shall we?

[h3][b]The Cabin in the Woods[/b][/h3]
We've been designing and implementing a forest environment where, with a bit of exploration, you might even find a secluded cabin. This area is still in progress. Our plan is to add some more elements, flesh out the details of the surroundings, and create some different iterations of the forest and cabin that will depend on the puzzles you'll need to solve to investigate the area! But so far, we think it looks pretty good (and pretty mysterious too)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/a6ab0eaf6bf3c0543069141f4f2889decfc28214.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Final Chapter[/b][/h3]
Reworking the final part of the narrative has been a focus of ours since the demo left Steam and, although we're keeping our cards close to our chest when it comes to the actual story, we're pleased to say that this final chapter has now been finalised and is ready for development!

[h3][b]City Construction[/b][/h3]
And finally, we've been expanding the city with some interior spaces! Three brand new city apartments have been under construction and who knows, maybe you'll be visiting them for interrogations, interviews, or even to find informants 👀 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/2304ebaed39baf2f41bded2843607e6bdada385d.gif[/img]

And that's all for now! This is only a glimpse of what's happening on the other side of the screen for [b]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.[/b] but we hope you've enjoyed the insight.

Thanks so much for your support, we'll be calling on you detectives soon! 

~ Maria and Andreas, [i]beyondthosehills[/i] 🐱

notes.title: We just announced our new game, the noir comedy Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I.!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there,[/h2]

[b]We’re thrilled that we can finally reveal our latest project in the works: [i]Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. [/i]releasing late 2022![/b]

If you like film noir, sci-fi, and crude animal humour, then this is just for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/41edb5f339d54e84b87cc23ebf809c7be6a373f7.gif[/img]

[i]“Albert Wilde is down on his luck. He’s broke, he’s friendless, he can’t get a girl, and his landlord won’t let him pee on the office wall anymore. 

When a pole-dancing flamingo stumbles upon a dead body in an abandoned warehouse, Albert decides that solving the case will also solve all his other problems. 

If only life were so simple…”[/i]

Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. is definitely different for us, but we’re so excited to be working on something new and something we think you’ll really enjoy. So, what can you expect from the game?

[list]
🐱 A loveable deadbeat hero on the road to redemption
🎞 A bold blend of film noir, sci-fi, and crude animal humour!
📺 Innovative black and white graphics in a vintage inspired 4:3 aspect ratio
🐷 Cunning villains! Ravishing dames!
🔍 Solve a mystery by interrogating suspects and exploring 3D crime scenes in first cat-person
⏱ An easy to play accessible adventure 4-5 hours long
🎙 Captivating voice-overs (from human and animals alike)!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593395/09be8dd41cb17acdb636fd57404a3c5d5d656aa3.png[/img]

But who are we? We’re Maria and Andreas, an indie dev team based out in Athens, Greece. Making games is our full-time job, and so we’re so happy to be announcing this latest project of ours. It’s a wacky blend of genres we love, mixing film noir, comedy, astrophysics, and plain ol’ weirdness. Oh - and cats! 

You can check out the demo for Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. right now at the Steam Next Fest, and why not give us a wishlist if you haven't already?

[h3]Find us on Steam:[/h3] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810670/Albert_Wilde_Quantum_PI/

We’re also happy to announce that the official [i]beyondthosehills[/i] Discord community is now live and we’d love you to get involved. Be the first to know about Albert Wilde and other future projects, talk to the team behind [i]beyondthosehills[/i], and meet and chat with like-minded people!

[h3]Join us on Discord: [url=https://beyondthosehills.com/discord]https://beyondthosehills.com/discord [/url][/h3]

That’s all from us for now, we hope you enjoy Albert Wilde: Quantum P.I. as much as we’re enjoying working on it!

~ Maria and Andreas, [i]beyondthosehills[/i] 🐱
